translation: In treating a single dislocation, use the manual method to take down the one that is not dislocated; hold the lower jaw with both hands, pull it slightly outward and then push it back inward, and then both will enter the upper ring. Then use cloth to wind from the chin (地閣) around the top of the head to secure it; one should internally take Zheng Gu Zi Jin Dan (正骨紫金丹), and externally stick Wan Ling Ointment (萬靈膏). After the person can eat and drink, remove the cloth, and only use cloth to hold up the lower jaw.
